bible.summary: Apartment block stairwell: landing with neighbours' padded doors (door-left 12, door-right 13), block of mailboxes and a notice with tear-off strips, elevator doors with a floor arrow, electrical box, bare bulb with wires along the ceiling, window to the yard with a geranium and a can ashtray, graffiti on the painted wall, stairs going up on the right, tiled floor — neighbours meet, someone rings the doorbell; variant inside the elevator cabin.

variants.change: inside a cramped elevator cabin: wood-grain panel walls, mirror on the left of the back wall, inspection plaque and a taped-up notice, button panel with one burnt button, dispatcher call button and speaker on the right, handrail, bright ceiling lamp, ribbed rubber floor; room for only two or three people (left, right, back against the mirror)

bible.prompt: soviet apartment block stairwell landing, two padded apartment doors with numbers, elevator doors, stairs with railing going up, painted green lower wall, bare bulb
